dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, continuous 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a sharp terminal point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Visible convex bulge along the right lateral margin near the mid-section; left margin displays a more linear profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high-intensity reflectance, showing subtle blue-grey shifts in shaded or submerged areas.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse, low-frequency grey clusters localized primarily to the anterior dorsal region and the vicinity of the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient observed between the anterior grey pigmented regions and the primary white epidermal baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Parallel transverse dark lines visible across the nuchal region; single dark punctate mark located on the mid-left dorsal flank.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Transverse topological depressions located behind the head, casting visible shadows along the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct transverse parallel lines in the nuchal area, appearing as healed scars or deep epidermal folds.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharply defined longitudinal dorsal ridge extending from the mid-dorsal plane toward the posterior.
